claims.statement: A minimal relevant-coordinate counterexample to G<=aI+bU is tensor-prime and satisfies (1-b)Delta_i U + sum_{j!=i} Delta_i Delta_j U > a Inf_i at every coordinate. Therefore the reverse inequality at one coordinate of every tensor-prime Boolean function is sufficient for universal GU.
claims.quantifiers: Every finite n, every genuine Boolean f, every fixed a>=0 and 0<=b<1.
dependencies: U-universal Theorem G and GU' restriction induction
claims.open_leaf: Prove GC14 in all dimensions on tensor-prime Boolean functions.

claims.statement: The symmetric four-bit weight-{1,2} gate is tensor-prime and forces 4a+11b>=53 for the second-order good-coordinate criterion; its tensor powers preserve the local obstruction.
claims.scope: Obstruction to this induction criterion only; not a GU or FEI counterexample.

claims.statement: GC14 holds for all 65,812 Boolean truth tables through four variables; the worst ratio is exactly 53/4.
